contract.failure_behavior: Missing rights, metadata, digest match, API declaration, grid identity or units keeps the source BLOCKED. Do not enable fetches from this report. contract.local_result: Propose FetchResult.data as explicit model-grid records, source as a separately reviewed source identity, fetch_time as retrieval UTC, records_count=len(data), and explicit had_errors/error_messages. No existing enum value should disguise a new product.

contract.query: Require explicit supported dataset/product, longitude, latitude, start/end UTC, variables and relevant height/depth. Reject unsupported identifiers before any I/O. Bound selection to the actual regional footprint.
contract.station_boundary: BaseClient.fetch_historical expects station_id and datetimes, while upstream takes lon/lat and string times. A deterministic grid-point identifier and separate hindcast model record are unresolved. fetch_stations and fetch_realtime must explicitly reject unsupported operations rather than invent stations or forecasts.

The catalogue and publisher terms are general; per-file exceptions and exact product applicability remain unresolved. Package LGPL-2.1-or-later does not grant dataset rights.

Two requests returned HTTP 404: a package-linked project page and an initially misresolved relative catalogue link. Current catalogue links were resolved using the effective redirected catalogue URL. All successful and unsuccessful bodies are retained outside the checkout with request time, status, command exit and digest.
NORA3 descriptive text contains historical production dates; no current temporal-coverage claim is made. Current NorKyst v3 metadata is not proof of equivalence to the package legacy route.

Embedded excerpts have independent digests; full HTTP bodies remain outside the repository. Regeneration checks excerpt consistency and local source digests. The optional evidence directory additionally checks full retained-body digests.
Offline tests establish validator behavior only; no live data access, engineering qualification, redistribution approval or validated benchmark is claimed.
Package licensing, dataset rights, API existence and engineering qualification must be verified separately.
